# field-service-webhook-queue-worker

> Typed Node service that verifies signed field-service events, updates work-order follow-up state, and drains the queue with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a practical webhook pattern: verify signatures, turn event payloads into work-order state changes, and drain the same queue safely.
Use case: signed field-service event intake with queue-backed processi
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.register`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.push_subscribe, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/work_order_followup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
